beats.care: Renting a room or PG near the IT corridor? Ask whether the building has approval for all its floors, especially new, narrow towers.
beats.what: GHMC and Malkajgiri corporation have flagged about 1,000 illegal buildings, and Cyberabad corporation has demolished 500 structures so far.
beats.why: Two under-construction buildings collapsed at Anjaiah Nagar in Gachibowli, killing two people, and a multi-storey building tilted in Gopanpally.

cards.body: Malkajgiri commissioner T Vinay Krishna Reddy said the drive against illegal construction has been stepped up over the past month. His corporation has razed over 100 buildings still under construction.
Siasat notes that is about as many as GHMC used to flag in a whole year.
cards.caption: illegal structures flagged across three corporations

cards.body: Officials are mainly hitting buildings still under construction, before families move in.

opts: They can collapse and hurt neighbours
cards.q: Why are officials targeting tall buildings on small plots?
cards.why: Floors added without approval on tiny plots can be structurally unsafe, as the Gachibowli collapse showed.

hook: 7 floors on a *50-yard plot*? Hyderabad is flagging 1,500 such buildings

learn.t: Officials are targeting five-to-seven-floor buildings squeezed onto tiny 50–75 square yard plots, which can endanger neighbours.

sources.name: Siasat Daily
sources.title: After building collapse, Hyderabad flags 1500 illegal structures

tldr: After a deadly building collapse in Gachibowli, Hyderabad's civic bodies have flagged over 1,500 illegal structures.
watch: Officials say demolitions follow within two weeks of a notice, and the drive will continue across the city.
